//: Shared compiler settings for every TypeScript plugin in this registry. Each plugin adds a
tsconfig.plugins.<name>.json that extends this file and supplies only its own paths, mirroring how
the daemon repo compiles the same plugins today — the two builds must agree, because a plugin moved
here has to produce the same JavaScript it produced there.
skipLibCheck is not optional. Without it the build fails inside nested dependencies of
@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent (a JSON import without an import attribute, a path into
undici-types that does not resolve) — 44 errors, none of them in Elowen's own types or in plugin
code. The daemon sets it for the same reason.
declaration is off because nothing consumes these plugins as a library: the daemon imports the
built index.js at runtime and never type-checks against it.
HOW A PLUGIN GETS THE DAEMON'S TYPES: `import type { PluginContext } from 'elowen/dist/plugins/api.js'`.
The daemon has since declared a stable `elowen/plugin-api` subpath for exactly this, and that is where
these imports should point — but it landed after 0.28.1, the version this repo installs from npm, so
the deep path is what resolves TODAY. The daemon's exports map keeps `./dist/*` open precisely so this
keeps working, and a contract test there fails if that wildcard is ever dropped. Switch these imports
to `elowen/plugin-api` when the elowen devDependency moves past 0.28.1.
